"""Repeat the bounded investigation in the established pinned browser image."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, tarfile, tempfile, sys
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = root.parents[3]
(root / 'evidence').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
out = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='run-', dir=root / 'evidence'))
raw = out / 'raw'
raw.mkdir()
relative = out.relative_to(repo)
files = sorted(set(p for folder in ['src', 'tests', 'data/maps', 'docs/prototypes/new-game/T63'] for p in (repo / folder).rglob('*') if p.is_file()) | set(root.glob('*.ts')) | {root / 'run.py', root / 'CONTRACT.md', repo / 'package.json', repo / 'package-lock.json', repo / 'playwright.config.ts'})
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
inputs = {str(p.relative_to(repo)): p.read_bytes() for p in files}

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=root.parents[3]
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='controls-',dir=root/'evidence'))
sha=lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
cases=[('ownership-shapes', 'src/ui/referenceMapView.ts', 'badge.setAttribute("d",seatLook(seat).badge);', 'badge.setAttribute("d",seatLook(0).badge);'), ('quiet-names', 'src/styles.css', '#reference-map .name { font-size:9px; font-weight:400; stroke:none; }', '#reference-map .name { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; stroke:none; }'), ('interactive-names', 'src/styles.css', '  font-size:12px; font-weight:600; stroke:#f8f2e2; stroke-width:1.5;', '  font-size:9px; font-weight:400; stroke:none;'), ('accessible-ownership', 'src/ui/referenceMapView.ts', 'n.setAttribute("aria-label",description);', 'n.setAttribute("aria-label",id);')]
records=[]
for name,relative,old,new in cases:
    path=repo/relative
    original=path.read_bytes()
    assert original.decode().count(old)==1
    mutated=original.decode().replace(old,new).encode()
    (out/(name+'-original.txt')).write_bytes(original)

        path.write_bytes(mutated)

    finally:

        assert path.read_bytes()==original
        if records: records[-1]['restoredExactly']=True
    (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')

# Army-first region labels — issue 137

The owner requires remaining presentation and interaction work before the game can be shown. This bounded change removes the duplicate seat number, gives each army count the same ownership silhouette used in the score legend, and makes visible names smaller/lighter until hover, keyboard focus or selection. Full name/seat/army/owner descriptions remain in accessible labels and native titles. Existing battle selection still names its source and target.

The four existing palette paths have extents94×34 (rounded pill),76×34 (hexagon),60×34 (rectangle),76×38 (diamond). They normalize to44×20 map units: the old badge width with two extra height units to contain bold count glyphs. These are derived drawing dimensions and designed presentation choices, not rule values. All T63 geometry, hit paths, regions, routes, core, saves and actions remain unchanged.

Measured evidence:
- `evidence/run-jt3i08w3`:4 actual-negative browser cases on unchanged game; combined seat/army text and absent emphasis fail at both sizes. Original sources, output and opening screens retained.
- `evidence/run-l7fcflsn`:initial4/4 positive; later fit checks exposed issues not covered by the first probe.
- `evidence/run-14ndxxtw` and `run-javii4jo`:existing nonoverlap assertions catch overly wide pill badges; both541-action games and battle controls already passed. `diagnose-fit.py` adds temporary rectangle diagnostics and restores the exact test in finally; its failed run is also retained. The pill extends beyond its straight segment, so uniform scaling was insufficient.
- `evidence/run-eeg2fq6f` and `run-656ddr18`:strict large-stack containment catches bold143 extending less than one CSS pixel below the18-unit badge. The latter retains exact rectangles; assertion condition unchanged.
- `evidence/run-_ag5bjv0`:6/6 focused cases pass after44×20 normalization; intentional two-reference-golden regeneration. Its source-change flag correctly records that snapshots were updated during this run.
- `evidence/controls-azhhgapr`:4 source-deletion classes caught, both source paths restored byte-exact: ownership shapes, quiet names, interaction emphasis, accessible ownership. Complete original/mutant sources and raw runs retained. These checks preceded the final badge-height-only adjustment.
- `evidence/run-g02rj6sl`:final18/18 pinned cases without snapshot updates; all recorded source bytes unchanged during run. Includes actual opening/four-seat ownership,143-army real-save upload, mouse/keyboard/touch, selected-region context, Stop/threshold/pending capture min/max/stale controls and both541-action complete replays.

The owner requires remaining presentation and interaction work before the game can be shown. This bounded change removes the duplicate seat number, gives each army count the same ownership silhouette used in the score legend, and makes visible names smaller/lighter until hover, keyboard focus or selection. Full name/seat/army/owner descriptions remain in accessible labels and native titles. Existing battle selection still names its source and target.

The four existing palette paths have extents94×34 (rounded pill),76×34 (hexagon),60×34 (rectangle),76×38 (diamond). They normalize to44×20 map units: the old badge width with two extra height units to contain bold count glyphs. import hashlib, json, subprocess, tempfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=root.parents[3]
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='controls-',dir=root/'evidence'))
sha=lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
cases=[('ownership-shapes', 'src/ui/referenceMapView.ts', 'badge.setAttribute("d",seatLook(seat).badge);', 'badge.setAttribute("d",seatLook(0).badge);'), ('quiet-names', 'src/styles.css', '#reference-map .name { font-size:9px; font-weight:400; stroke:none; }', '#reference-map .name { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; stroke:none; }'), ('interactive-names', 'src/styles.css', '  font-size:12px; font-weight:600; stroke:#f8f2e2; stroke-width:1.5;', '  font-size:9px; font-weight:400; stroke:none;'), ('accessible-ownership', 'src/ui/referenceMapView.ts', 'n.setAttribute("aria-label",description);', 'n.setAttribute("aria-label",id);')]

All 4 author controls work as designed. Each mutation breaks the tests in the expected way.

1. Independently delete at least one protected presentation behavior in actual source, rebuild and show its assertion failure; restore exact original bytes in finally.

- ownership-shapes (ReferenceMapView.ts line 33)
- quiet-names (styles.css line 1282)
- interactive-names (styles.css line 1286)
- accessible-ownership (ReferenceMapView.ts line 31)

What's not covered:
- Count being shown (count only shows army number, not combined)
- Position of count text (count.getAttribute("x"))
- Badge alignment (translate/scale)
- Centre marker
- Stroke of badge (#d7e4eb)

Let me think... what about the title textContent update? `n.querySelector("title")!.textContent=description;` — if this is removed, the native title would not be updated. But the test checks aria-label, not title.

What about removing the badge stroke or count weight? Let me try something different.

Actually, the brief says I need to test at least one mutation that's covered by the controls. Let me try one of the author's deltas to confirm. Wait, no - "Independently delete at least one protected presentation behavior" - I should test my own mutation.

Let me try a meaningful new mutation. What about removing the badge code altogether? Let me try deleting the badge transform.

Actually, a cleaner test: I want to confirm that count fits within badge. The current fit assertion uses `c.left>=b.left && c.right<=b.right && c.top>=b.top && c.bottom<=b.bottom` - i.e., count inside badge. This is one of the new test diagnostics. Let me see if there's a way to make this fail by mutation.

Let me try deleting the `replaceWith(s("path",{class:"badge"}))` line. This would leave the old rect badge in place. The rect badge is 44×18. But the count text would still need to fit inside the rect.

Actually, looking at the diff in `referenceMapView.ts`:
```
n.querySelector(".badge")!.replaceWith(s("path",{class:"badge"}));
```

If I remove this, the original SVG rect badges (44×18) remain. The new fit test passes with those too because 18 is still ≥ the count height. Let me see the rect height.

The original badge: `<rect class="badge" x="352" y="52" width="44" height="18" rx="5"/>`. Width=44, height=18. So if I remove the replaceWith, the badge stays as rect 44×18.
